snapshot_policy: Full snapshots and diffs remain local and ignored. Scheduled Actions persist and upload hashes, flags and metadata only. Local explicit review keeps the last two compressed snapshots. No content enters Git or dist.

schedule.B: Day 1 each month 05:31 UTC, minimum one calendar month
schedule.C: Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct day 1 05:43 UTC, minimum three calendar months

activation: Workflow is prepared on the feature branch. GitHub schedule/workflow_dispatch requires the workflow on the default branch (master); no default-branch merge was performed.
runtime: Real baseline file activity window about 5.2 minutes; future checks vary by server response. Six workers, one request per host, at least 2 seconds after each response (longer robots delay wins); 60-minute fetch budget and 90-minute job timeout.
repository_policy: Only non-content metadata enters Git. Passages, diffs, human-readable queues and full baseline reports remain local and ignored.
